one_line: OlympiadBench exposes bilingual olympiad-level math and physics, including multimodal cases as an auditable evaluation surface.
OlympiadBench 把双语奥赛级数学与物理题（含多模态题目）做成可审计的评测面。
why: High-difficulty contest source with multilingual and multimodal slices.

title: Problem
问题
html:
OlympiadBench asks whether LLMs and LMMs can solve bilingual, multimodal olympiad-level mathematics and physics problems rather than easier school-exam or general STEM QA items. The primary source is the arXiv paper submitted on 2024-02-21, revised on 2024-06-06, and marked as accepted to ACL 2024 main; the official OpenBMB repository provides the evaluation code and public release notes.

The evaluation surface is a problem record drawn from International Olympiads, Chinese Olympiads, or difficult GaoKao segments. A record can contain a problem statement, optional image material, context for progressive physics problems, solution annotation, subfield labels, answer type labels, and a reference target. The benchmark includes 8,476 problems, with math and physics, English and Chinese, text-only and multimodal slices, and both open-ended and theorem-proving tasks.

The atlas boundary is evaluation and audit, not a training recipe or a proof assistant dataset. Its value is that it turns high-difficulty contest reasoning into a reusable benchmark surface with an explicit answer-level scoring contract for many open-ended items, while leaving proof and text-description cases as a manual or non-programmatic boundary.

OlympiadBench 要回答的问题是：大语言模型和多模态模型能否处理双语、多模态、奥赛难度的数学和物理题，而不是只在普通 STEM 问答或较低难度考试题上得分。主要来源是 2024-02-21 提交、2024-06-06 修订的 arXiv 论文，论文页标注为 ACL 2024 main 接收；OpenBMB 官方仓库发布了评测代码和数据更新说明。

它的评测对象是一条竞赛题记录，来源包括国际奥赛、中国奥赛和高考较难部分。记录可能包含题干、图片、渐进式物理题的上下文、标准解、子领域标签、答案类型和参考答案。全集有 8,476 题，覆盖数学/物理、英文/中文、纯文本/多模态，以及开放式问答和定理证明两类任务。

收录边界是 benchmark/evaluation surface，不是训练配方，也不是形式化证明数据集。它对 atlas 的价值在于把高难竞赛推理压成可复用的样本结构，并为大量开放式题目提供明确的答案级评分契约；证明题和文字描述题仍处在手工判断或非程序化边界内。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a curated bilingual multimodal olympiad benchmark for math and physics, paired with annotations and a scoring pipeline that can evaluate many free-form numerical or symbolic final answers. The core mechanism is not a new solver: it sources contest PDFs, parses them with OCR, cleans and deduplicates records, annotates question type, subfield, and answer type, and evaluates model outputs against normalized reference answers when the answer type is programmatically checkable.

The feedback contract is answer-level. Numeric values are compared with tolerances, symbolic expressions and equations are checked with symbolic computation, intervals and tuples are decomposed into comparable elements, and theorem-proving or categorical textual answers are outside the full automatic scoring contract. This makes the benchmark closest to hard scientific reasoning benchmarks such as SciBench, ScienceQA, MMMU, MathVista, and GaoKao/AGIEval-style exam suites, but OlympiadBench narrows the scope to olympiad-level math and physics with many image-bearing problems.

The direction label is high-difficulty domain-expert evaluation. Reuse should preserve the distinction between automatic-score open-ended items and proof/textual items, because the benchmark's strongest evidence comes from the answer-level verifier rather than from a universal reasoning-step judge.

核心贡献是一套面向数学和物理的双语多模态奥赛 benchmark，并配套题目注释与可评测大量自由形式数值/符号答案的评分流程。它不是提出新解题器，而是从竞赛 PDF 获取题目，经 OCR、清洗、去重、题型/子领域/答案类型标注后，把模型输出与规范化参考答案比较。

反馈契约是答案级。数值答案按容差比较，表达式和方程用符号计算判等，区间和元组拆成元素比较；定理证明、分类讨论或文本描述类答案不属于完整自动评分覆盖范围。它最接近 SciBench、ScienceQA、MMMU、MathVista、GaoKao/AGIEval 这类科学或考试评测，但 OlympiadBench 的边界更窄，集中在奥赛难度数学和物理，并保留大量带图题。

方向标签是高难度领域专家评测。复用时必须把可自动评分的开放式题和证明/文本题分开，因为它最强的证据来自答案级 verifier，而不是通用的过程级推理裁判。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are official contest PDFs or exam materials, image assets, extracted text, and reference solutions or answers. The construction pipeline is:

  1. Collect math and physics problems from International Olympiads, Chinese Olympiads, and difficult GaoKao sections.
  2. Use Mathpix OCR to parse PDFs, then manually inspect, clean, revise, and deduplicate records with LLM-assisted similarity checks.
  3. Annotate problem type, subfield, answer type, and progressive-problem context when later physics questions depend on earlier material.
  4. Package data into categorized files whose names encode open-ended versus theorem proving, multimodal versus text-only, subject, language, and competition or GaoKao origin.
  5. Run model inference with prompt templates that expose the answer type and required final-answer format but do not add hidden knowledge-point hints.
  6. Score automatic-scoring-available open-ended items through the official evaluator; theorem-proving items receive sampled manual analysis rather than full automatic verdicts.

Outputs are benchmark records, model outputs, answer-level scores, and error analyses. The verifier uses floating-point comparison for numeric values, SymPy-style symbolic equivalence for expressions/equations, and elementwise comparison for intervals and tuples. Reproducibility requires pinning the dataset version, prompt template, model access date, evaluator code revision, tolerance policy, and whether multimodal images are supplied to the tested model.

输入包括官方竞赛 PDF 或考试材料、图片资源、OCR 后文本，以及标准解或参考答案。构造流程是：

  1. 从国际奥赛、中国奥赛和高考难题部分收集数学、物理题。
  2. 用 Mathpix 解析 PDF，再人工检查、清洗、修订，并用基于向量相似度的 LLM 辅助去重。
  3. 标注题型、子领域、答案类型；物理渐进题还把共同材料和前序答案组织进上下文字段。
  4. 将数据打包成分类文件，文件名编码开放式/证明题、多模态/纯文本、学科、语言、竞赛或高考来源。
  5. 用固定 prompt 模板进行模型推理，模板暴露答案类型和最终答案格式，但不额外提供知识点提示。
  6. 对可自动评分的开放式题调用官方 evaluator；证明题只做抽样人工分析，不给全量自动判定。

输出是 benchmark 记录、模型回答、答案级分数和错误分析。verifier 对数值用浮点容差，对表达式/方程用符号计算判等，对区间和元组做元素级比较。复现时需要固定数据版本、prompt 模板、模型访问日期、评测代码版本、容差策略，以及多模态图片是否真正输入给模型。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main source evidence is the released arXiv paper, the OpenBMB repository, and the Hugging Face dataset. The paper reports 8,476 total problems, 4,869 with images, 8,476 with solutions, 6,728 open-ended questions, 1,748 theorem-proving questions, 6,142 math problems, and 2,334 physics problems. The official repository reports full-benchmark scores including GPT-4o at 25.89 average, GPT-4V at 17.97 average, and a text-only GPT-4 score of 29.93.

The decisive row-level evidence for automatic-score items is not the aggregate leaderboard but the evaluator's comparison between extracted model final answer and reference target. Numeric, expression, equation, interval, and tuple cases have a programmatic contract; proof and categorical text cases do not have the same machine-checkable guarantee.

The evidence boundary is therefore narrow. Reported percentages depend on the public dataset version, prompt format, model snapshot, image handling, answer extraction, tolerance choices, and evaluator implementation. The paper itself documents failure modes where a correct physics answer can be marked wrong because the tolerance or expression-equivalence policy is insufficient.

主要证据来自 arXiv 论文、OpenBMB 仓库和 Hugging Face 数据集。论文报告全集 8,476 题，其中 4,869 题含图，全部有解答；开放式题 6,728，道证明题 1,748；数学 6,142，物理 2,334。官方仓库的榜单给出 full benchmark 上 GPT-4o 平均 25.89、GPT-4V 平均 17.97，以及 text-only 任务上 GPT-4 平均 29.93。

对单条样本真正起决定作用的证据不是 aggregate leaderboard，而是 evaluator 对模型最终答案和参考答案的比较。数值、表达式、方程、区间、元组有程序化契约；证明题和分类文字题没有同等强度的机器验收。

证据边界很明确：分数依赖公开数据版本、prompt 格式、模型快照、图片输入策略、答案抽取、容差设定和 evaluator 实现。论文也记录了评分系统可能误判的情形，例如物理题容差不足或表达式等价判断能力不够时，正确答案可能被判错。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is a mix of math, science, exam, and multimodal benchmarks: GSM8K/MATH-style math sets, GaoKao/AGIEval-style exam suites, SciBench-like scientific problem solving, and multimodal sets such as ScienceQA, MMMU, CMMMU, and MathVista. OlympiadBench changes the object by focusing on olympiad-level math and physics, including bilingual records, many image-bearing problems, expert solution annotations, and progressive physics contexts.

The new direction signal is the combination of contest-level difficulty and an explicit answer-type-aware evaluator for free-form scientific answers. Its quality signal is not that every item is automatically verifiable; rather, it clearly separates automatically scoreable open-ended answers from proof/text cases that require manual treatment.

What is not new: OCR, benchmark curation, answer-format prompting, numeric tolerance, and symbolic equivalence checking are existing techniques. Before reuse, inspect the exact data version, source-rights chain for contest problems, Hugging Face dataset license, GitHub code license, evaluator tolerance settings, OCR/image fidelity, and whether scores are being compared on the same multimodal/text-only slice.

已有基线包括数学、科学、考试和多模态 benchmark：GSM8K/MATH 类数学集，GaoKao/AGIEval 类考试集，SciBench 类科学解题集，以及 ScienceQA、MMMU、CMMMU、MathVista 等多模态集。OlympiadBench 的变化在对象层：集中收奥赛难度数学和物理题，同时保留双语、含图、专家解答标注和物理渐进题上下文。

方向信号是把竞赛级难度和按答案类型设计的自由形式科学答案 evaluator 结合起来。质量信号不是“所有题都能自动验证”，而是清楚地区分可自动评分的开放式答案与需要人工处理的证明/文本题。

不新之处包括 OCR、benchmark 整理、答案格式 prompt、数值容差和符号等价判断。复用前要检查具体数据版本、竞赛题来源权利链、Hugging Face 数据许可、GitHub 代码许可、evaluator 容差设置、OCR/图片忠实度，以及比较分数时是否使用同一多模态或纯文本切片。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness holds relative to the extracted benchmark record, reference answer, answer-type label, and evaluator code. It does not prove that the OCR text and image crop perfectly preserve the original contest problem, and it does not certify reasoning quality when a model reaches a correct final answer through a flawed process.

The automatic verifier has known blind spots: proof problems and categorical text answers are not fully covered; physics tolerances may need problem-specific precision; symbolic equivalence can fail for expressions that are mathematically equal but not normalized in the evaluator's supported form. Public release also creates contamination risk for later model training.

Reuse should not treat OlympiadBench as a hidden live benchmark, a training reward source, or a general proof-quality judge without additional controls. License and redistribution checks should distinguish repository code, Hugging Face dataset metadata, and the rights attached to original contest/exam problems.

正确性只相对于抽取后的题目记录、参考答案、答案类型标签和 evaluator 代码成立。它不自动证明 OCR 文本和图片裁剪完全忠实于原始竞赛题，也不证明模型的推理过程正确；模型可能用错误过程得到正确最终答案。

自动 verifier 有明确盲区：证明题和分类文本答案不能全量自动覆盖；物理题可能需要逐题容差；数学等价表达式如果没有落入 evaluator 支持的规范化形式，也可能判错。公开发布还带来后续模型训练污染风险。

复用时不能把 OlympiadBench 当作隐藏 live benchmark、训练 reward 来源或通用证明质量裁判。许可和再分发检查应区分仓库代码、Hugging Face 数据集元数据，以及原始竞赛/考试题自身的权利边界。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
OlympiadBench is useful as a recipe for hard scientific evaluation surfaces: keep source provenance, language, modality, subject, subfield, problem type, answer type, context, image references, reference answer, solution, prompt template, model output, extraction result, and evaluator verdict as separate fields.

For benchmark design, it shows how to make free-form scientific answers more auditable by constraining the final-answer format and routing different answer types to different comparison methods. For model analysis, it provides a stress test for bilingual mathematical reasoning, physical reasoning, diagram use, and error taxonomy.

The atlas value is strongest when used as evaluation-only evidence. If someone wants to convert it into training data, reward modeling data, or verifier training data, they need a separate lineage, license, contamination, and verifier-fidelity audit.

OlympiadBench 可作为高难科学评测面的 recipe：复用时应保留来源 provenance、语言、模态、学科、子领域、题型、答案类型、上下文、图片引用、参考答案、标准解、prompt 模板、模型输出、答案抽取结果和 evaluator 判定。

对 benchmark 设计来说，它展示了如何通过限制最终答案格式，并按答案类型分流到不同比较方法，让自由形式科学答案更可审计。对模型分析来说，它可用于压测双语数学推理、物理推理、图像使用能力和错误类型。

它在 atlas 中最适合作为 evaluation-only 证据。若要转成训练数据、reward modeling 数据或 verifier 训练数据，需要额外做来源链、许可、污染和 verifier 忠实度审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the dataset-construction and scoring sections before the leaderboard. The key distinction is between benchmark difficulty and verifier coverage: a hard problem can be included even when its proof-style answer is not automatically scored.

Keep full benchmark, text-only subset, math, physics, English, Chinese, open-ended, and theorem-proving claims separate. Aggregate accuracy is a model-comparison number; row-level evidence is the evaluator verdict or manual proof/text assessment under a specific scoring policy.

阅读时先看数据构造和评分流程，再看榜单。关键边界是 benchmark 难度不等于 verifier 覆盖范围：题很难并不意味着所有答案都能自动验收，证明类答案尤其要单独看。

full benchmark、text-only、数学、物理、英文、中文、开放式题和证明题的结论要分开。aggregate accuracy 是模型比较数；单条样本证据是特定评分策略下的 evaluator 判定，或证明/文本题的人工判断。
